items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: He played with Louis one time. He was the same man Louis Armstrong was in one time in Chicago.

ctx.x: Now what about Johnny Sincere? Who did he play with?

He played with Louis one time. He was the same man Louis Armstrong was in one time in Chicago. Johnny was, Johnny Sincere. And he was very popular in the band. Johnny's quite a man. He's quite a band man, Johnny Sincere's, you know. He was quite a guitar. Of course his main way of making his living, I know you know that, but I tell you. The pleasure of living, you know. But he was quite an able man in the band, Johnny was, some years ago. Quite a guitar player.
Who did he play with down here? Do you remember?
